purpose: Read-only inspection of the latest Tesla account feature configuration, with an explicit server refresh action, summary counts, distribution gauge, composition chart and searchable feature details.
primaryGoal: Inspect which Tesla account features are enabled or disabled, distinguish Boolean and configured entries, examine configuration details and refresh the account snapshot without losing retained data.

dataSources.name: useTeslaFeatureConfig
dataSources.ownership: useUser.ts owns the query and TeslaConfigEnvelope; page derives presentation through feature-local pure helpers.
dataSources.routeEvidence: internal\api\router.go:3599-3601 mounts GET /feature-config and POST /feature-config/refresh under /tesla/user. web\src\App.tsx:260,723 lazy-loads and mounts TeslaFeatureFlagsPage at /tesla-features.
dataSources.behavior: useUser.ts:89-99 defines the envelope, forwards AbortSignal and uses STALE_TIMES.EXTENDED. One account-level query feeds all four content units. No date/vehicle scope is supplied; account snapshots are not date-range totals.
dataSources.backendLimit: Router registration was inspected, but handler/cache implementation, upstream response guarantees, refresh atomicity, authentication and live responses were not exercised. No units or undocumented backend capabilities are inferred.

dataSources.name: useRefreshTeslaFeatureConfig
dataSources.ownership: useUser.ts owns mutation, query invalidation and success/error toasts.
dataSources.routeEvidence: internal\api\router.go:3601 rate-limits this POST to 5 requests per minute per IP.
dataSources.behavior: useUser.ts:105-112 performs POST, invalidates userKeys.teslaFeatureConfig on success and uses localized mutation toasts. Page lines 59-69 disables Refresh while pending; section retries call GET refetch, not POST refresh.
dataSources.backendLimit: No production mutation was performed. The page comment describes re-pulling Tesla data; router/hook evidence proves the request path, not upstream operation success.

dataSources.name: parseFeatureEntries / summarizeFeatureEntries / buildFeatureComposition
dataSources.ownership: Feature-local pure presentation derivation; raw envelope remains in TanStack Query.
dataSources.behavior: Non-record payloads become an empty row array. Plain objects become configured entries; other values use Boolean coercion. Configured enabled is Boolean(value.enabled); remaining object properties become verbatim key plus JSON.stringify(value) details. Entries sort by key. Totals and enabled percentage derive from rows; zero-total percentage is 0 internally. Composition contains only present kinds, ordered flag then configured.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.detail: Existing full-width min-w-0 adapter wraps PageContainer. Page passes title, subtitle, secondaryActions, query and one dataSources descriptor. PageContainer.tsx:194-222,253 owns compact subtitle help, freshness and source notice. Do not duplicate shell header or workspace selectors.

components.name: FeatureConfigOperationalBrief
components.detail: Existing OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics pipeline owns total, enabled, disabled and enabled-rate metrics, compact summary, snapshot scope and provenance. useAccountSnapshotPeriod.ts:5-16 uses preference-aware dates; useAccountBriefStatus.ts:5-20 maps actual DataStatus.

components.name: FeatureConfigDistribution
components.detail: Persistent GlassPanel/PanelTitle, LinearGauge percentage, enabled/disabled Badge counts, synced timestamp and independent Skeleton/QueryError/EmptyState.

components.name: FeatureConfigComposition
components.detail: Persistent GlassPanel, EmbeddedChart, responsive grouped bars, translated kind labels, integer count axis, ChartTooltip, ChartLegend, enabled/disabled series and accessible data columns. Existing chart key is admin-feature-config-composition.

components.name: FeatureConfigTable
components.detail: Existing DataTable pipeline with four columns, local search/status filter, deterministic sort, enableValueFilters, complete filterData, stable row keys, matching counts and pagination. Persistent tableId is admin:tesla-feature-flags.

components.name: Shared chart, table, motion and feedback owners
components.detail: EmbeddedChart forwards children to ChartContainer with no duplicate surface; export/fullscreen default false. DataTable.tsx:237-248,715-725,873-916,1385-1438 owns mobile visibility, exports and opt-in mobile adapter. FadeIn.tsx:24-34 honors useMotionPreference. Existing Button, Input, Select, Badge, GlassPanel, typography, Skeleton, EmptyState and QueryError should be reused, not reimplemented.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Distribution GAUGE_COLOR and composition ENABLED_COLOR independently define the same #10b981. Composition additionally defines #64748b at FeatureConfigComposition.tsx:21-22.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse the existing shared semantic chart palette for enabled/disabled meaning rather than maintaining duplicate literal palettes; preserve legend text and series identity.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: A single fatalError is passed to distribution, composition and table, each rendering its own recovery UI while PageContainer also owns the source notice. These are one source failure, not independent failures.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Coordinate one primary source explanation with concise local unavailable context while retaining all persistent sections and all existing refetch recovery paths. Do not delete repeated data views as cosmetic duplication.

sourceBehavior: TeslaFeatureFlagsPage.tsx:92-113 stacks overview panels until xl, then allocates distribution one column and composition two.
FeatureConfigTable.tsx:173-192 stacks filters below sm and uses a fixed sm:w-52 status control above sm.
FeatureConfigTable.tsx:145 uses min-w-0; PageLayout.tsx:12-13 provides full-width container-query-compatible layout.
Composition uses ResponsiveContainer; actual allocated chart height and small-screen legend/axis fit were not exercised.

issues.detail: mobileColumns includes only key/enabled. DataTable.tsx:715-725 applies hidden md:table-cell to Type and Details. This caller supplies no mobilePresentation, expandable row or detail navigation; phone users therefore lose in-page access to configured type/details.
issues.fix: Adopt the existing DataTable mobilePresentation contract or an existing expanded-detail presentation preserving all four fields, full detail strings, sorting, value filters, pagination and export scope. Do not hide secondary content without an equivalent reachable view.

accessibility.status: source only; keyboard, focus, screen reader, touch targets, contrast and reduced-motion runtime unverified
sourceStrengths: Page sections have translated aria-labels at TeslaFeatureFlagsPage.tsx:84,93.
Refresh has visible localized text and an aria-hidden decorative icon; Input and Select have localized aria-labels at FeatureConfigTable.tsx:182,189.
Status and kind badges retain visible text; composition has ariaLabel and dataColumns at FeatureConfigComposition.tsx:65,72-76.
FadeIn.tsx:24-34 uses reduced-motion preference; wrappers retain all children.

issues.detail: Feature keys and configuration details are visually truncated and exposed through native title attributes at lines 100 and 135. Full text remains in DOM, but title is not a reliable keyboard/touch detail mechanism; below md the details cell is hidden altogether.
issues.fix: Provide a keyboard/touch-reachable full-text row detail using the existing table presentation/overlay owners or wrapping text. Keep exact raw keys and JSON detail content; do not replace them with shortened values.

issues.detail: Refresh communicates pending through disabled plus animate-spin but does not pass Button.loading or aria-busy. The shared FadeIn motion path is inspected, but this icon relies on CSS reduced-motion behavior not exercised here.
issues.fix: Use existing Button loading/busy semantics while retaining the localized name and pending disable behavior; verify shared CSS suppresses decorative spin under reduced motion.

states.initialLoading: Page summary receives null plus loading for source.status initial. Distribution Skeleton, composition EmbeddedChart loading and table eight-row/four-column TableSkeleton preserve their shells.
states.empty: Distribution total===0 uses EmptyState; composition absent kinds uses empty chart; table empty entries explains header Refresh recovery. An empty plain-object envelope still yields numeric zero metrics and an available summary status; null data yields unknown summary metrics. These distinctions need review, not invented replacement data.
states.fatalError: deriveDataState.fatalError replaces only child content; panels remain. Every local retry forwards the GET refetch function; PageContainer also owns source notices.
states.refreshError: Page passes only fatalError to children, keeping last-good entries, metrics and charts. Summary sourceStatus carries stale; header query/dataSources preserve nonblocking trust context.
states.offlineStale: deriveDataState.ts:158-177 classifies retained paused/error sources as stale and exposes refresh blocking. Child widgets do not independently receive stale/offline flags; shared page source notice is the owner. Live offline behavior unverified.
states.mutation: POST refresh disables its button while pending, invalidates GET on success and emits success/error toasts. GET retry and POST refresh must remain separate actions.

issues.rule: MDC-025 / MDC-026 / unknown is not zero
issues.detail: deriveDataState is called without unavailable/partial options. For {data:{},fetched_at:null}, hasData is true, the summary receives zero counts and zero percent at line 85, and useAccountBriefStatus labels it available; all detail panels show no data. A malformed non-record payload also parses to no entries without an explicit partial/unknown state.
issues.fix: Resolve the successful-empty versus unavailable payload contract with the existing dataState owner and actual API evidence. Use unavailable/partial and missing metric values where appropriate, preserving legitimate false flags and true measured zero counts. Do not change Boolean coercion or invent upstream states without evidence.

visualIssues.detail: Two hardcoded series colors and a repeated hardcoded gauge color bypass palette ownership. All three panel title icons independently apply text-cyan-300 (composition:58, distribution:53, table:148), adding accent to every section rather than reserving semantic emphasis for enabled status.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing palette and neutral/icon tokens; retain restrained enabled-versus-disabled meaning, distinct text labels and accessible data alternatives. Do not introduce neon, glow, new hex colors or a replacement surface.

architectureIssues.detail: PanelTitle imports from @/components/ui/Typography rather than the UI category barrel. Distribution.tsx:5 does the same; the table already imports typography through @/components/ui.
architectureIssues.fix: Consolidate feature typography imports through @/components/ui; keep shared implementations on concrete internal imports to avoid barrel cycles.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-044 / shared locale and timezone owner
architectureIssues.detail: Distribution directly calls lib formatDateTime without options, which defaults to browser locale/timezone (dateFormat.ts:29-35,55-63). Summary snapshot uses useDateFormat through useAccountSnapshotPeriod.ts:7,13, honoring saved locale/tz (useDateFormat.ts:74-97). The same snapshot can display inconsistent date formatting.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing useDateFormat in distribution while preserving fetched_at and both snapshot-context and synced-footer presentations. Never add a local date formatter or workspace date filter.

priority.reason: Mobile hides configured details/type without another in-page access path; resolve this preservation gap before decorative modernization.
orderedWork: Preserve complete mobile details and long-text keyboard/touch reachability.
Align empty/unknown snapshot trust semantics using real API evidence.
Unify saved date preference handling, loading semantics and category imports.
Subdue decorative accents and reuse palette ownership; verify all four content units and controls in ten widths/themes.

competingImplementations.detail: Barrel still exports FeatureConfigKpis while mounted page uses FeatureConfigOperationalBrief at page lines 36,85. The old KPI implementation was not inspected and no second mounted use is established.
competingImplementations.fix: Keep modernization on the current OperationalBrief metric pipeline. Do not reintroduce the older KPI component or remove an exported component without separate caller evidence.

competingImplementations.detail: Direct default-browser date formatting competes with the preference-aware snapshot date owner used by the summary; this is the architecture issue already recorded, not a second requested shared formatter.
competingImplementations.fix: Adopt useDateFormat; retain both presentations and unchanged UTC source.

actions: Header Refresh POST, localized label, pending disable/spin, success/error toast and GET invalidation.
GET retry/refetch from distribution, composition and table fatal-error views; shared source notice recovery.
Free-text search of exact feature key and details; All/enabled/disabled status filter.
Feature, type and status sort toggles with stable key tie-break.
DataTable value filters on all four columns using complete safeEntries filterData.
DataTable pagination, page-size settings, persisted table layout/width state and matching loaded-row CSV/JSON export controlled by existing DataTable defaults.
Chart legend interaction and canonical accessible data alternative owned by ChartContainer; exact mounted legend persistence/toolbar capabilities unverified.
OperationalBrief shared details affordances, subject to actual source-backed shared implementation; no new domain mutation or toggle capability.
dataBehavior: One account-level envelope query and one explicit POST refresh; no duplicated query, vehicle selector or date-range picker.
Keep raw Tesla keys and all configured non-enabled properties with JSON representations; never translate/recase source keys.
Retain Boolean coercion and kind classification pending explicit upstream-contract review; non-record parsing remains nonthrowing.
Keep total/enabled/disabled/enabledRate calculations, both count breakdowns, grouped series and observed fetched_at timestamp.
Preserve query key, AbortSignal forwarding, stale policy, invalidation/toast behavior and retained-data recovery.
Keep exact tableId admin:tesla-feature-flags and chartKey admin-feature-config-composition; exports include matching loaded data, not a fabricated server full-result fetch.
Unknown values must not become fabricated measurements. No SI physical conversions, backend fields or cache mutations are introduced.
Keep every panel visible through loading/empty/error; no gating whole page behind envelope availability.
Preserve current localized visible labels and accessible names, summary snapshot provenance, formatting precision/preferences and reduced-motion wrapper behavior.
Composition EmbeddedChart defaults exportable/fullscreen false; do not claim or invent existing chart export/fullscreen actions.
